title: Expanded View CSV: column order, blank-cell rules, and the Locations line
refs: SV-8612 (specs/sbc-sales-by-customer.md Story 14 S14-R6..R9 — Expanded View CSV,Customer/Asset/Invoice breakdown + Locations: line,per Chris Ward msg 2026-07-29 [last-update-wins]; old S14-R10 flat/no-asset-layer rule superseded)
custom_preconds: 1. You have downloaded the CSV for a view with at least one customer with several invoices.
custom_steps:
1. Read the header row.
2. Read a customer row and an invoice row.
3. Look for any asset-level rows.
custom_expected:
1. The Expanded View CSV has the twelve columns in this exact order: Customer, Invoice #, Date, Inv. Hrs, Labor Invoiced, Labor Margin, Parts Invoiced, Parts Margin, Shop Supplies, Margin, Margin %, Subtotal.
2. On customer rows the Invoice # and Date cells are blank.
3. On invoice rows the Customer cell is blank and the Invoice # and Date cells are filled.
4. Customer names are plain - the "(N)" invoice count is not included.
5. The rows follow the Expanded View's Customer, then Asset, then Invoice breakdown - note how the asset level appears (this level is NEW; its exact representation is confirmed from the updated spec and the build - the older spec had no asset rows in the file).
6. The file carries a "Locations:" line naming the location(s) the report was scoped to (exact position in the file is confirmed in the build).
